_comment: Repo-managed opencode permission block, merged into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by /deploy-global (opencode scope). Additive and idempotent; a rule already present in the user's config wins. Leading ~ is expanded to $HOME at merge time so this file stays portable. Every entry is a directory opencode must reach WITHOUT an interactive prompt, because an unattended run (status-fetch, a spawned subagent) has nobody to answer it. The deploy discovers and validates an installed Bash 5+ only when the user has no `shell` key. SHAPE: this is the V1 `permission` object on purpose. OpenCode 2 reads it and normalizes it to its `permissions` array with the order preserved (measured with `opencode debug config` on 2.0.9, 2026-09-20; `bash`->`shell`, `task`->`subagent`), and an additive jq merge into an ordered last-match-wins array is materially harder to get right. Never let both shapes exist in one config: they set the same canonical value and the native V2 form wins, silently dropping this one.
